title: Syrian Tagine Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Syria, typically cooked in a clay pot. This recipe uses a tagine-inspired flavor profile with tender potatoes.
instructions: Heat the tagine spice blend in a clay pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped potatoes, stir to combine, and cook for 10 minutes.
Pour in the Syrian water or broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Season with additional tagine spice blend if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
